correctness.rationale: The degree-nine squarefree polynomial x^9−x gives a smooth genus-four hyperelliptic normalization with one rational point at infinity. Over F9, x^9−x=0 so N2=10. For x in F81 outside F9, v=x^9−x obeys v^9=−v, v^40=−1 and is a nonsquare, giving N4=10 and B4=(N4−N2)/4=0. Independently enumerated the 81-element field using u^4+u−1, confirming nine-element F9 and no additional points. Aubry–Herbaut–Monaldi Proposition 2.2 implies B_r>0 whenever (q^(r/4)−1)^2 >=2g; exact inequalities at q=3,g=4,r=5 establish the upper threshold and monotonicity covers r>5. This proof uses the published theorem as an input, not an unverified finite extrapolation.
